normalization_conventions: The common-subquotient lemma concerns one private current-root representation; any added coordinates mentioned in Section 2 must remain within that representation, including constant coordinates. Arbitrary auxiliary or tensor dynamics are not covered.

A common positive normalization means one positive scalar rho_s per letter, multiplying the entire represented letter, hence a multiplicative scalar rho(w) on words. It does not mean separate rescaling of each composition character.
The tensor escape is an algebraic monomial representation; it is not an assertion that hidden-route cloning or an extra observation is physically legal.
